progression.prerequisiteKnowledge: C1: reversible reactions run both ways; dynamic equilibrium means equal non-zero rates in a closed system; equal rates do not mean equal amounts. Rate means how much changes per second, and more particles available means more events per second.
progression.startsWith: A sealed, steadily heated flask filled with only phosphorus pentachloride.
progression.stopsAfter: Explaining how forward and reverse rates change from a reactant-only start until they are equal and the concentrations stop changing, and reading both graph types.
progression.nextLesson: C3: what a flask already at equilibrium does when it is disturbed.

teaching.task: Explain how a reaction that starts with only reactant reaches equilibrium, and predict the pattern for a products-only start.
teaching.causalExplanation: Each reactant molecule has the same chance of splitting each second, so fewer molecules means a falling forward rate; products cannot rejoin until they exist and meet more often as they build up, so the reverse rate rises; the concentration of each substance is the net result of the two rates, so equal rates give steady concentrations while both reactions keep running.
teaching.conversationalApproach: One sealed phosphorus pentachloride flask followed stage by stage with made-up rate numbers, a colour clue, the C1 two-towns traffic picture, and a products-only start for the learner to predict.
teaching.openingDecision: How does a flask that starts with only reactant end up as a mixture that never changes?
teaching.understandingCheck: Predict the rates and concentrations for a flask that starts with only phosphorus trichloride and chlorine, and say whether the reactions are still going at equilibrium.
teaching.curriculumScope: Describe how the rates of forward and reverse reactions change over time until equilibrium is reached, using collision-theory reasoning and concentration and rate graphs (CH12-12). K, Le Chatelier, catalysts and activation energy are deferred to later lessons.

design.visualSystem: Explainer engine: warm paper stage, handwritten Caveat headings, amber doodle layer, coded flask with 20 particles, rate bars and live graphs, with a painted flask pair for the colour evidence. Colour key: PCl5 navy, PCl3 violet, Cl2 green, forward blue, reverse amber, equal teal.
design.transitionPlan: Stopper presses in and the camera pushes into the flask; the board slides from flask and table to the two-panel graph layout; the colourless flask plate crossfades to the pale yellow-green plate; the towns doodle replaces the flask; scene crossfades with settle.

scenes.visualReference: Painted hot sealed flask (or coded flask) with equation chip and stopwatch
scenes.teachingReason: Poses the puzzle of a reactant-only start before any mechanism
scenes.motionPurpose: Equation arrows light in turn and the stopper seals the flask
scenes.onScreenChange: Heading writes on; the stopper presses in on "sealed"; the equation chip writes on at "split" with the blue forward arrow lit and the amber reverse arrow lights at "join"; the stopwatch starts at 0
scenes.holdPurpose: Brief look at the sealed flask

scenes.visualReference: Coded flask with 20 navy particles, rate bars and first table row
scenes.teachingReason: Establishes the starting stage: forward rate at its highest, reverse rate zero, with the cause for each
scenes.motionPurpose: Navy particles split while the forward bar grows and the reverse bar stays empty
scenes.onScreenChange: Camera zooms into 20 navy particles; the forward bar grows to 50 on "fifty" as some particles split into violet and green; the reverse bar stays empty with a pen ring on "zero"; the first table row writes in
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the first table row and the empty reverse bar

scenes.visualReference: Same flask at stage 1 with the earlier row ghosted and the gap column added
scenes.teachingReason: Shows why the forward rate falls and the reverse rate starts, and links the rates to the net change
scenes.narrationCue: forty / started / meets / forward is still bigger than reverse / keeps falling
scenes.motionPurpose: Forward bar shrinks to 40, a violet and a green particle join into navy as the reverse bar rises to 8, and the net arrow shortens
scenes.onScreenChange: Forward bar shrinks to 40 on "forty"; a violet and a green particle drift together and merge on "meets" while the reverse bar rises to 8; a pen bracket spans the bar difference on "forward is still bigger"; the gap column and the net arrow shrink from 50 to 32 on "keeps falling"
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the two rows side by side

scenes.visualReference: Same flask at stage 2 with only the last two table rows in full
scenes.teachingReason: Shows the gap between the rates shrinking while the reactant still falls
scenes.motionPurpose: Rate bars close to 35 and 17 and the net arrow shrinks to 18
scenes.onScreenChange: Rate bars move to 35 and 17; a pen bracket spans the gap on "gap" and the net arrow shrinks to 18; the "closer" table row writes in while earlier rows ghost; splits become rarer and joins more frequent

scenes.visualReference: Same flask at equilibrium plus the painted colourless and pale yellow-green flask pair
scenes.teachingReason: Shows equal rates giving steady concentrations while both reactions continue, with a visible colour clue
scenes.motionPurpose: Rate bars lock together, the net arrow vanishes, and the flask plate crossfades to pale yellow-green and then stops darkening
scenes.onScreenChange: Bars lock at 30 with a teal "equal" bracket on "equal" and "net change 0" replaces the net arrow; the equilibrium row writes with a teal highlight; split and join events keep running with a "still happening both ways" tag; on "yellow-green" the colourless flask plate crossfades to the pale plate and a swatch strip fills then stops
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the equal bars while the colour stops changing

scenes.visualReference: Two aligned coded graphs: concentration against time above and rate against time below
scenes.teachingReason: Lets the learner read the whole journey in both graph types and corrects the reaction-stops idea
scenes.motionPurpose: Four curves draw live and the rate curves merge into one flat line at 30
scenes.onScreenChange: Board slides to two stacked graphs; the PCl5 curve draws on "falls" and the PCl3 and Cl2 curves rise together; forward and reverse rate curves draw on "falls" and "rises" and merge; a teal dashed line marks the equal point; a pen traces the flat line down to 30 and a crossed "the reaction stops" bubble appears

scenes.visualReference: C1 two-towns traffic doodle, swap diagram and memory aid
scenes.teachingReason: Gives a mental picture for rates meeting, and a memory aid that works for either start
scenes.motionPurpose: Blue traffic thins while amber traffic builds until both lanes match, then the swap diagram flips and the aid writes on
scenes.onScreenChange: Cars all drive right at first; blue traffic thins on "left" as amber cars build on "back" until both lanes match; the swap diagram flips the faster and slower labels on "the other way round"; the aid writes on with falls, rises and level underlined
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the aid on screen to read

scenes.visualReference: Coded products-only flask with 20 violet and 20 green particles and three numbered questions
scenes.teachingReason: Unseen transfer to a products-only start with all conditions visible
scenes.motionPurpose: Countdown ring runs through the answer-free thinking hold
scenes.onScreenChange: Products-only flask and the three numbered questions appear as named; the equation chip stays for reference; the countdown ring starts after the narration
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet answer-free thinking hold with countdown

scenes.visualReference: Same flask run in reverse, taller rate axis, ghosted first run and small rate-time graph
scenes.teachingReason: Explains the products-start answer, shows the same final mixture and names the likely wrong answers
scenes.narrationCue: forward / rises / same mixture / falls / still going
scenes.motionPurpose: Violet and green merge into navy at a high reverse rate, the counts settle on 12, 8 and 8, and the small graph draws the swapped curves
scenes.onScreenChange: Forward bar empty with a pen ring on "forward"; the navy count climbs from 0 on "rises" and settles on 12, 8 and 8 on "same mixture"; a small rate graph draws reverse falling and forward rising with the first run ghosted on "falls"; wrong-answer chips appear crossed as each is named
scenes.holdPurpose: Settle on the matching flat level

scenes.visualReference: Five-step story with small rate-bar icons and a final flask
scenes.teachingReason: Gives the reusable order of events for any how-does-it-reach-equilibrium question and hands off to disturbances
scenes.motionPurpose: Five story steps write on one by one and the final flask shakes at "disturb"
scenes.onScreenChange: Five steps write on in turn with rate-bar icons; the steady-state flask shakes slightly on "disturb" and a next-lesson chip appears
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the five steps to read

scenes.visualReference: Key notes card with the memory aid in large writing
scenes.motionPurpose: Notes appear then stay still for copying
scenes.onScreenChange: Five notes and the aid appear and lock
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet copy hold with pause invitation
